recommendation_summary: The reply recommends wrapping the cron job on edna so a non-zero exit sends a failure email and a zero exit pings a heartbeat URL, and running a self-hosted Healthchecks container on the Synology that emails the user if the ping doesn't arrive by 04:00.
note: It recommends two alert mechanisms plus a self-hosted Docker service on the Synology, and none of the four labelled record lines appear.
